title: Source cohomology germs for the small coordinate-ring colimit model
statement: Let S be a scheme, s:Spec Ω→S a geometric point with Ω algebraically closed, L∈D⁺(Ab(S_et)), and n∈ℤ. Use the adopted derived-sections presheaf, homology germ map and affine representative functor of [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs]. On the small coordinate-ring-colimit scheme T=strictHenselizationScheme(s) with g=strictHenselizationStructuralMap(s), define a source isomorphism from the geometric stalk of Hⁿ(L) to Γ(T,Hⁿ(g⁻¹L)): take the uniquely characterized germ restriction of [def-weil-pbc-small-strict-local-section-cone], prove it invertible, and compose with exact-inverse-image homology. Define the source legs on the identical affine representative diagram as presheaf germs followed by the stalk map of the adopted homology germ comparison and this source isomorphism. All these definitions apply in every integer degree, with no qcqs assumption. The target uses the small model T, not the adopted strictLocalization(s).

source.place: Tags 03Q8 (lemma-higher-direct-images), 03Q9 (theorem-higher-direct-images, neighbourhood-colimit and injective-complex paragraphs), and 03QO (lemma-vanishing-etale-cohomology-strictly-henselian)

proof.text: Apply existsUnique_restriction to the homology sheaf using the existing small-model pointed section cone. The uniquely specified residue identification gives a geometric lift y compatible with every cone leg and the base map. The prime-comap formula for the residue map puts y over the closed point. On a strictly henselian local scheme the identity-neighbourhood germ computes global sections, so PointedEtaleSectionCone.isIso_restriction makes this very same chosen restriction an isomorphism. Compose it with global sections of the exact inverse-image/homology comparison. Mark the source-isomorphism definition irreducible for efficient use and prove its explicit forward-map equation by unfolding it once.

Reuse the adopted presheaf, homology germ map and affine-neighbourhood functor. Follow each presheaf germ by its induced stalk homology map and the small-model source isomorphism constructed above. The presheaf-fibre cocone equation proves naturality. For the defining source-leg equation, move the homology comparison through the germ by presheaf-fibre naturality, then apply the uniquely characterized restriction equation. This gives the section restriction followed by exact inverse-image homology, without requiring consumers to unfold the source-isomorphism construction.

def smallModel_strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) :
    strictLocalCohomologyNeighbourhoodFunctor s L n ⟶
      (Functor.const _).obj
        ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology
          AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj L)))
